public_rationale: This claim lists several things generative AI was not doing. One of them, 'not generating any revenue', was plainly false in mid-2024. OpenAI was reported to be on a $3.4 billion annual revenue pace in June 2024. Microsoft said AI services added 7 points to Azure's revenue growth in the quarter ending March 2024. Nvidia credited generative AI demand for record data center revenue. One clearly false part makes the joined statement false as written. The productivity and GDP part may well have been fair: no measured macro gain was clear by then. That part was not settled here, and it does not save the revenue part.
limitations: OpenAI's figure is a run rate from an anonymous source, not reported revenue.
The productivity, GDP, killer-app and industry-change parts were not tested decisively.
Nvidia figures come from a news report of the release.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI has no killer apps, does not meaningfully raise productivity or GDP, generates no revenue, and is not creating jobs or transforming industries.

statement.excerpt: In essence, on top of generative AI not having any killer apps, not meaningfully increasing productivity or GDP, not generating any revenue, not creating new jobs or massively changing existing industries, it also requires America to totally rebuild its power grid, which Janous regrettably adds the US has kind of forgotten how to do.

from_speaker: not meaningfully increasing productivity or GDP
not creating new jobs or massively changing existing industries
our_interpretation: Plain reading: as of July 2024, generative AI was producing no revenue at all, along with the other stated absences.
The claim joins several parts with 'and'. It is false if any firm part is clearly false.
'Not generating any revenue' is the most testable part: any substantial revenue contradicts it.
He named no period. I use 2024-01-01 to 2024-07-08.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence that generative AI produced no revenue, no measurable productivity or GDP effect, and no jobs in the first half of 2024.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Company-reported or credibly reported revenue from generative AI products or services in the first half of 2024.

evidence.excerpt: OpenAI is on pace for $3.4 billion of annual revenue, Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman told the company's staff, according to a person familiar with the matter.
evidence.explanation: OpenAI, a pure generative AI company, was bringing in revenue at a pace of $3.4 billion a year. This is a run rate, not full-year revenue, but it shows revenue was well above zero.

evidence.excerpt: Inside of the Azure growth, 7 percentage points were related to AI, up from 6 points of impact in the previous quarter.
evidence.explanation: Microsoft reported that AI services added 7 points to Azure's revenue growth in the quarter ending March 2024. That is realized AI revenue.

evidence.excerpt: "Our datacenter growth was fueled by strong and accelerating demand for generative AI training and inference on the Hopper platform," said Jensen Huang
evidence.explanation: Nvidia credits generative AI demand for its record data center revenue ($22.6 billion that quarter, per the same article).
